messages:
marta: RCA live for the routing-degradation incident — link: https://redwood.internal/postmortems/2113334445-rca

marta: Short summary: misapplied routing policy during autoscale caused ~25% of traffic to land on a partially warmed pool; we saw 5xx spikes for ~12m. Recovery: rollback + manual warm-pool bringup.

marta: Key artifacts on the page: timeline, logs, decision record, and owner matrix. Checkpoint sync Fri 09:00 PT.

sasha: taking A1 (add CI guardrail to block unsafe routing changes). ETA: 2026-04-03. Posting PR when ready.

devon: A2 assigned (investigate KB cache eviction interaction with routing). Pairing with engops. ETA: 2026-04-10.

priya: A3 I'll update the deploy playbook and runbook to include immediate warm-pool steps + rollback checklist. PR: https://github.com/redwood/runbooks/pull/590 :white_check_mark:

alex: A4 I'll add route-coverage metric and a dashboard panel. Draft: https://grafana.redwood/team/serving/d/route-coverage

engops: A5 ops policy: temporary cap on routing shifts >20% in 5m without manual approval. Scheduling canary for next week.

oncall-bot: incident INC-2026-4129 created, timeline + logs attached.

sasha: helpful log excerpt:
```
2026-03-18T07:12:03Z WARN routing.cpp:143 rule_evaluate id=route-v2 selected=false pool=warm-pool
2026-03-18T07:12:03Z ERROR loadbalancer.cpp:88 pick_target returned null
```

marta: Please ack your ownership in-thread. We'll add short status updates by EOD Wed for the checkpoint agenda.

devon: ack, pairing session scheduled.

priya: runbook PR linked above. also added customer comms summary to the RCA page.

alex: alert thresholds set to page at <80% route coverage for 2m.

engops: canary window confirmed: Mon 09:00 PT. ops lead: devon.

marta: thanks everyone — good recovery. We'll close items after checkpoint if PRs & canary look good.
